verified_from_code: Recent fitting labels endJune22 exclusive; later evaluation beginsJune22. Historical feature queries use only views before each snapshot cutoff.
Future schedule features remain permitted programme availability/channel/hour exposures, not future viewing behaviour.
Early and recent windows are concatenated only for fitting; later labels are not passed to model.fit. early_stopping=False prevents implicit validation access.
Feature-name arrays must match across cached snapshots. Eager loading avoids repeated archive decompression.
AP@5 and common cold fallback come from reviewed evaluate implementation. Original May18July27 evaluation is explicitly invalid for these models.
reporting_caveats: Protocol wording independent snapshots should mean distinct chronological snapshots, not statistically independent samples: users and historical data overlap.
Later window was already explored, so performance is a reused holdout estimate, not untouched test confirmation.
Pooling weights rows equally, not users or windows equally; high-activity users and the snapshot with more candidates contribute more loss. This is a valid modeling choice, not a leakage bug.
Persisted feature names ensure schema alignment but do not alone prove identical builder semantics; retain each feature archive/code hash for reproducibility.
